To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have shown a high throughput and accurate measurement method for TSV depth control.
we have developed an innovative metrology concept for high speed TSV RST measurements.

1) the TSV depth can be measured with an accuracy of 0.5 µm by measuring the RST, 2) the RST is measured with an accuracy better than 0.5 % and a repeatability of 0.2 %, 3) the RST measurements on a rotational sample stage are fast and reliable, 4) a statistical approach is used to increase the throughput of the measurements.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a fast and reliable metrology solution to control the TTV processing of TSVs.
a new metrology approach to measure the remaining silicon thickness of a 3D device.
the optimization of TSV metrology in a production environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented approach can be used to control the TCV depth and therefore the TSV processing in a fast and reliable way.
the presented metrology approach is a fast and reliable method to control the TCV depth in the TSV processing chain.
this method is suitable for the TSV metrology and can provide a fast feedback for process control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TSV depth can be accurately measured with the proposed approach.
this method is a fast, reliable and efficient way to monitor the TSV processing.
the TSVs depth can be accurately measured in a fast and reliable way, which can be used to control the underlying TSV processing.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RST measurements are very fast and accurate and can therefore be used in a production environment to optimize TSV processing and improve yield of the final device.
